name: automated-processes
description: Per-branch PostgreSQL databases and one-click project scripts.

automatedProcesses.envFile.markdownDescription: Env file with the database URL, relative to the workspace folder. Only read, never changed.

automatedProcesses.loadEnvFileIntoComman.markdownDescription: Pass every variable from `#automatedProcesses.envFile#` to scripts, migrations, new terminals and debug sessions. Useful on Windows, where tools that only read real environment variables don't see `.env`.

automatedProcesses.env.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for every command. Supports placeholders such as `${db.url}`, `${db.name}`, `${testDb.url}`, `${env:NAME}` and `${branch}`.

automatedProcesses.applyToTerminals.markdownDescription: Put the current database (and env file values, if enabled) into new VS Code terminals.

automatedProcesses.database.urlVariables.markdownDescription: Variables pointed at the **current** database. The first one, read from the env file, defines the main database and the server.

automatedProcesses.database.mainBranches.markdownDescription: Branches that use the main database. The first one that exists locally is used to detect merged branches.

automatedProcesses.database.dockerCompos.markdownDescription: Docker Compose service running PostgreSQL. When set, `psql`, `pg_dump` and `pg_restore` run inside it (`docker compose exec`), so nothing needs installing locally. Leave empty to use the tools from PATH.

automatedProcesses.database.hidePatterns.markdownDescription: Databases hidden from the list (glob patterns, e.g. `*_test`, `*_test_gw*`). Hidden databases are pre-selected in **Clean Up Databases**.

automatedProcesses.database.newNamePatte.markdownDescription: Suggested name for new databases. Placeholders: `{main}`, `{branch}`, `{branchShort}` (last part of the branch), `{issue}` (leading number of the branch, else `{branchShort}`).

enumDescriptions: Drop the database (and its test databases) of a branch once it's merged into a main branch or deleted.
Only unlink it; the database stays.
automatedProcesses.database.onBranchMerg.markdownDescription: What happens to a branch's database when the branch is merged into a main branch or deleted.

automatedProcesses.testDatabase.envFile.markdownDescription: Env file holding the test database URL (e.g. `.env.test`). Empty = `#automatedProcesses.envFile#`.

automatedProcesses.testDatabase.urlVaria.markdownDescription: Variables pointed at the current **test** database (e.g. `TEST_DATABASE_URL`). Empty turns per-branch test databases off. The extension only points them; the test suite creates the database.

automatedProcesses.testDatabase.nameSuff.markdownDescription: Test database name = branch database name + this suffix.

automatedProcesses.migrations.command.markdownDescription: Command that applies migrations to the current database, e.g. `npx prisma migrate deploy`. Runs after **New Database**, after **Migrate** (see `#automatedProcesses.migrations.afterCopy#`) and on branch change.

enumDescriptions: Never run migrations on branch change.
Run them automatically (never on the main database from a feature branch).
automatedProcesses.migrations.onBranchCh.markdownDescription: Run migrations when you switch to a branch that has its own database.

automatedProcesses.migrations.afterCopy.markdownDescription: Run migrations on the target after **Migrate** copies a database.

automatedProcesses.scripts.markdownDescription: Script buttons for the sidebar. Each script runs its steps in order and stops at the first failure. Edit in `settings.json`.

icon.description: Codicon name, e.g. tools, checklist, sparkle.

env.description: Extra environment variables for this script. Placeholders allowed.

inputs.description: Dropdowns shown next to the button, used in commands as ${input:NAME}.

ifMissing.description: Skip when the target already exists.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
